title: Early-Payment Discount Computation — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**The invoice.** On a Service Accounts and Repair Orders account, the invoice reviewed is the repair order of the latest payment received on the account; its invoice date is the latest line date of its labor charges, its payment date is the date of that latest payment, and its unit is the vehicle on its labor charges. Wherever a record is chosen as the latest of its kind and two such records share that date, the one listed first in the records counts. Where no payment has been received on the account, or the paid repair order carries no customer-pay labor charge, there is no invoice to review and no discount.

**Paid in full.** The invoice is paid in full when its charges, customer-pay and deductible alike, less every credit on it, less the payments received on it, plus any payment returned on it, come to zero or less.

**Discount clause.** The early-payment discount is the discount rate times the discountable total, rounded half up to the cent, and is given only when the invoice is paid in full no more than the discount window of calendar days after its invoice date; otherwise there is no discount. The discount rate is the tier's early-payment discount share. The discount window is the tier's early-payment window of calendar days. The discountable total is the invoice's customer-pay labor and parts charges less the comeback, estimate overage and goodwill credits on it. No discount is given on an invoice whose customer-pay labor charges exceed the comeback, estimate overage and goodwill credits on it by less than 10.00 dollars.

**Order.** The discount is figured in this order: first every addition this policy sets out is added to the discount rate, giving one rate; then that rate is applied once to the discountable total; then every share this policy sets out that reduces the discount is applied; and the result is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Worked figures (hypothetical: 2% rate, 10-day window, invoice dated 4 March)
| Customer-pay labor | Parts | Credits (comeback, overage, goodwill) | Paid in full on | Discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1840.00 | 612.35 | 0.00 | 14 March (10 days) | 2452.35 at 2%, 49.05 |
| 1840.00 | 612.35 | 0.00 | 15 March (11 days) | none |
| 1840.00 | 612.35 | 0.00 | 14 March, a 90.00 deductible unpaid | none — not paid in full |
| 26.40 | 0.00 | 18.00 | 6 March | none — labor exceeds credits by only 8.40 |
